key_insight: Ambient AI scribe evaluations use fragmented metrics, limiting comparisons across studies and leaving broader care-system effects underexamined.
clinical_relevance: Evidence on documentation efficiency should not be assumed to establish benefits for patient outcomes, safety, or team workflows.
method: Reviewed 54 studies evaluating ambient AI scribes in healthcare.
Examined study designs, data sources, and evaluation metrics.
Identified 10 evaluation dimensions, 40 metrics, and 96 operationalizations.
evidence_signal: Documentation efficiency and time were assessed in 44 of 54 studies, while 35 of 96 metric operationalizations (36%) appeared in only one study.
watch_item: Heavy reliance on self-report and inconsistent measurement limits evidence synthesis; safety and downstream effects need more systematic evaluation.
paper_title: Ninety-Six Ways to Measure a Scribe: Fragmented Evaluation of Ambient Scribes in Healthcare
